packetSummary: All 40 items have exactly one defensible option; I found no key errors or accidentally correct distractors. Weaknesses: (1) wording/assumption issues in 011 (unstated disjoint categories) and 025 (ambiguous 'twice the number increased by 18'); (2) 023 relies on multiplying negatives and indices, beyond Year 6; (3) 022 uses an invalid difficulty label 'challenging'; (4) 013 and 033 are too easy, and 033 is mis-tagged as probability (035 and 040 are counting, not probability; the packet has no true probability item); (5) overall the packet skews easy for scholarship level, with several 'medium' labels that read as easy (002, 006, 019, 031, 037), and few multi-step or reasoning items; (6) several items miss the classic misconception distractor (010 wrong base, 016 naive answer coincides with the key, 036 average-speed trap, 038 $396). Originality: all common-genre with fresh numbers; none looked like a near-copy of a specific published item, though 016, 019, 021, 022 and 032 are very stock types.
